svg.title: Two plans from the same start: one made step by step falls short, one worked back from the vision gets there.
svg.desc: The same drawing twice. Each starts from today, at the lower left, and each has a level marked at the upper right: where the product needs to be. In the first, a coordinator plans each step from the last. The work climbs in three small steps, on time, and ends well below that level, with a dotted gap above it: it falls short. In the second, a concept champion names the destination first: the vision, highlighted, sits at that level. A dotted arrow runs back from the vision to today, and the work climbs in three larger steps that reach it.
svg.text: plans each step from the last
names the destination, then works back
